lua_chon: $\int f\left( x \right).g\left( x \right)\,dx=\int f\left( x \right)\,dx.\int g\left( x \right)\,dx$.
$\int \left[ f\left( x \right)-g\left( x \right) \right]\,dx=\int f\left( x \right)\,dx-\int g\left( x \right)\,dx$.
